The above writ petition has been filed for the issue of a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to enhance the compensation in respect of petitioner's property in Re.S.No.37/1BA1 at Kumarakiri Village, Thoothukudi Taluk, by considering the petitioner's representations dated 13.06.2019 and 27.06.2019 and directing the respondents to fix the compensation as per the guideline value and under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,2013.

, the Writ Petition is closed.

However, there shall be no order as to costs.
